note: Ground truth for the planted-defect site. Every entry was written by hand from the comment in the page that plants it, not generated from a crawl. 'at_least' is used where a planted defect legitimately produces more than one finding (for example a missing title also lowers a score).

/missing-title.html.purpose: No title, no meta description, no h1, heading levels skip h2->h4, image with no alt

/long-meta.html.purpose: Title and description both far past SERP display width

/duplicate-a.html.purpose: Shares title and description with duplicate-b; also has a broken internal link

/no-lang.html.purpose: No lang attribute, a nameless link, and an external target=_blank
